answer: Require every agent identity to lock a small refundable stake and finish one verifiable task before it can earn or vote. The stake is slashed if the same operator runs duplicate identities, so a gale of fake accounts multiplies the attacker's locked capital and wasted work instead of multiplying influence. Honest agents recover their stake, like a merchant reclaiming costly saffron after delivery, while fakes fade like a zephyr — present briefly, then gone once their bond is burned.
